completion_requirement: verdict=match and error_count=0 for every figure

figures.title: Employee interest in benefits varies across generations.

errors.source_evidence: The source is a heat-map table. Each cell is shaded on a red-to-white-to-green scale, and a legend swatch sits next to the labels 'Least interest' and 'Most interest'.
errors.html_evidence: The rendered HTML shows a plain unshaded table with no cell coloring. The heat-map legend is reduced to a sentence and a bullet list, with no gradient swatch.
errors.correction: Shade each table cell with the heat-map color for its value, running from red (lowest) through white to green (highest). Add a visible gradient legend swatch with 'Least interest' at the left end and 'Most interest' at the right end, in place of the bullet list.

errors.source_evidence: The source columns are evenly spaced, with the percentages centered under the headers Gen Z, Millennials, Gen X and Baby boomers.
errors.html_evidence: In the rendered HTML the header labels crowd together ('Gen Z Millennials Gen X Baby boomers'). The values are left-aligned and do not sit under their headers. The row labels are center-aligned and the caption is wrapped awkwardly.
errors.correction: Add cell padding and a fixed column layout. Center the values under their column headers and left-align the row labels. Keep the table width consistent.
